current_clauses: Original bytes are held in a Map. Default sample15 and launch budget30000ms remain configurable; guarded default-config edge does not claim hard maxima for operator overrides.
Mutant write precedes remaining-budget calculation; each gate launch is bounded by remaining time and shared gate limit. Immediate restore precedes next trial; finally restores all originals.

TimedOut/cleanupFailed stops launches, restores and excludes incomplete trials. Any ordinary nonzero is unclassified rejection, not a measured killed mutant. Earlier adverse upper-bound evidence remains.

All completed passes yield zero score only with >=3 evaluated trials; fewer returns null. Safe writer wraps unsafe/failed restoration as UnsafeWorktreePathError; assessment returns fatal without blind retry.
